newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 1.8 pesos lower vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 1.8 pesos lower vs dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 1.8 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,061.25 in quiet trading on the interbank market, dealers said.
"There were no notable trades," one dealer said. "The corporate sector was quiet and normal pre-weekend trading dominated."

Dealers reported 256 trades for a lackluster total of $106.7 million and said the peso traded in a 1,062.40-to-1,059 range. Traders generally expected the peso to trend lower until April or May when an expected surge in coffee export revenues will put upward pressure on the local currency.
